scenarios.scenario-1: The command tree loads on import and the CLI entry resolves through the absolute launcher.
scenarios.scenario-2: Thrown typed errors are turned into one readable line plus the documented exit code.

required-log-markers.marker-1: CLI text output and JSON envelopes are asserted by the tests; no runtime log markers are emitted by library modules.

notes.note-2: The command surface is additionally cross-checked by scripts/validate-docs.ts in CI.
